name: Font in Logo · Airbnb Font is Cereal

title.zh: Font in Logo · 比较品牌字形
title.en: Font in Logo · Airbnb Font is Cereal

description.zh: 对照 Cereal 名称和右侧标志，再从字体入口继续核原始资料。 检索品牌标志字体的参考集合，目录并列标志、字体名与匹配类型，区分修改字形、近似字体和社区建议。单件页面展示品牌图和字体入口；Verified 是本站的标注，本次没有逐款核验品牌原始规范，字体许可与商标使用权需另查。
description.en: A reference collection for typefaces in brand logos, pairing logos and font names with match types such as modified, closest font, and community suggestion. Detail pages provide a brand image and font link. Verified is the site’s label; original brand guidelines have not been independently checked for each match in this visit. Font licensing and trademark permissions need separate verification.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Font in Logo (https://www.fontinlogo.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 对照 Cereal 名称和右侧标志，再从字体入口继续核原始资料。

Visual details from source observation: 我们从首页进入 Logos，往下看到标志与字体名并排，卡片还区分 Verified、近似字体和社区建议。建议先挑一项开详情，再看原标志和文字怎样对应：Airbnb 页把 Cereal 与粉红标志放在一起，字体入口在左侧。这里的 Verified 是网站自己给的标注，我们没有逐款核品牌规范；参考字形时还应单独核对字体许可，别把它当成品牌使用授权。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
